page.overview:
Who is Dragona Joestar?

On the character information page, the Japanese character 兄, meaning older brother, is used to describe Dragona. [https://www.shueisha.co.jp/books/reader/main.php?cid=9784088842981] of Jodio Joestar, as well as the user of the Stand, Smooth Operators.

Dragona is a slender 18-year-old with tanned skin and long, dark, dreadlocked hair that parts into long straight bangs. Upon their head they wear a wreath of flowers with some having elongated petals that are reminiscent of hands.

Dragona's appearance is heavily themed after dragons, as they have several stylized dragon tattoos on both shoulders and left thigh. Dragona also has triple claw-like tattoos on the chest, arms, and left thigh. Moreover, Dragona wears a necklace bearing a plate engraved with a stylized "D" which is made to look like a dragon. During the first appearance, Dragona wore a plain dark bikini with a belt and arm rings; however, in later appearances, Dragona dons a dress. To appear even more feminine, their breasts has been given cosmetic injections to make them more prominent.

As a member of the Joestar Family, Dragona has the Star Birthmark located on his left shoulder.
